capabilities: Extract values from frontmatter, inline fields, checkboxes and note text
Render month calendar views with streak coloring and annotations
Render line, bar, stacked bar and pie charts
Compute summaries with expressions such as sum(), average() and maxStreak()
Insert tracker code blocks via commands or manual code blocks
disambiguation: Not a task or to-do tracker; it aggregates numeric values and occurrences found in notes, not task lists.
extras: README warns of breaking changes: template variables like {{sum}} were deprecated in version 1.9.0 in favor of an expression syntax ({{sum()}}); detailed concepts, examples and settings live in linked documentation and a downloadable examples vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to aggregate numbers or occurrences recorded across notes and visualize them over time.

relations.evidence: Add support for inline dataview fields (including emoji support for values)

summary: Data tracker that extracts values and occurrences from note frontmatter, inline fields and text, then renders them as calendars and charts.
